features.name: grassy terrain base
features.notes: Covering the whole roughly 200x200 stud map; green grass with slight rolling-hills texture
features.quote: Grassy terrain base covering the entire map area, green grass color, flat with slight rolling hills texture.

features.name: winding dirt enemy lane
features.notes: Single continuous lane from one corner to the opposite corner; no branches, dead ends, ambiguous self-crossings; wide enough for enemies
features.quote: A single continuous, unchanging lane winding from spawn to the core

features.name: dark stone spawn portal
features.notes: At the start of the path in one map corner
features.quote: A dark stone archway or portal entrance at the start of the path

features.name: medieval fortress core
features.notes: At the far end of the path in the opposite corner; impressive landmark
features.quote: A medieval fortress at the end of the path

features.name: fortress walls battlements gate
features.quote: stone walls, battlements, and a gate facing the path

features.name: stone tower platforms
features.notes: Multiple flat circular and square platforms on both sides of the winding path at strategic positions
features.quote: Flat circular and square stone tower-placement platforms framing both sides of the winding dirt path

features.name: glowing platform edge markers
features.notes: Platforms visually distinct from grass with different color and glowing edges
features.quote: visually distinct from the grass with a different colour and a glowing edge marker

features.name: scattered medieval trees
features.notes: Several around map edges and between path curves
features.quote: Several medieval-style trees scattered around the map edges and between the path curves

features.name: rocks and boulders
features.notes: Various sizes placed around the map
features.quote: Various sized rocks and boulders placed as natural decoration around the map.
